_comment: Response headers for timotholt.com. GitHub Pages cannot set headers, so these are applied by a Cloudflare Transform Rule (Rules > Transform Rules > Modify Response Header) on the proxied zone. Keep this file and that rule identical; tests/csp.spec.ts loads every page under this policy.
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com; frame-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com; connect-src 'self' https://timotholt-chat.timotholt-chat-worker.workers.dev; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
